- Removed the surviving process logging-only wrapper (`ProcessLogIdentity`) by collapsing command/runtime logging state to `ProcessJobKind` only.
- Renamed emitted log attribute keys toward the task's dotted schema (`job.kind`, `process.stream`, `postgres.path`, `postgres.raw_line`, `runtime.startup_run_id`, `logging.level`, `dcs.mode.*`, `pginfo.sql.*`, `postgres_ingest.*`).
- `make check` is green again after those changes. Next I still need the structural logging-core split out of `src/logging/mod.rs`, then rerun the full validation targets.
